title: The Still House
description: A considered interior palette that turns a city apartment into a softer place to land.

cover.alt: Cartoon-style concept illustration of a sage apartment with a curved cream sofa, cane chair, and soft curtains; not a photograph

gallery.alt: Cartoon bedroom with a sage bedspread, cream bedding, and soft wood furniture
gallery.title: A softer place to rest
gallery.description: Cream bedding and muted greens carry the apartment's gentle palette into the bedroom, with storage kept visually quiet.

gallery.alt: Cartoon apartment kitchen with pale counters, sage accents, and warm wood cabinets
gallery.title: A considered kitchen palette
gallery.description: Pale worktops, warm cabinetry, and restrained sage accents explore an interior refresh without introducing an architectural redesign.

gallery.alt: Cartoon reading corner with a sage armchair, bookcase, side table, and floor lamp
gallery.title: A corner to slow down
gallery.description: A comfortable chair, nearby books, and a dedicated reading light turn an unused corner into a small daily retreat.

gallery.alt: Cartoon bathroom with a pale bathtub, wood vanity, round mirror, and folded towels
gallery.title: Calm morning routines
gallery.description: Soft tile tones, a timber vanity, and simple open towel storage bring the same sense of calm to a practical everyday room.

gallery.alt: Cartoon dining room with a wood table, sage chairs, pendant light, and greenery
gallery.title: A quiet dining setting
gallery.description: A compact shared table and warm pendant light create an inviting setting for meals while keeping the apartment palette cohesive.
